tiff_description_tag: tc - Tilt angle or total curvature - magnetic field derivative for edge detection
finding: Band 6 (`tc`) has Spearman rho = 0.99995 with USGS GeoDAWN radiometric Total Count (`TC`), not Bouguer terrain-corrected gravity. WBG-S2 treats Band 6 strictly as radiometric TC and uses Band 13 (`iso_grav_anom`) + Band 18 (`iso_grav_anom_hg`) for gravity operators.
